title: The Cooking Class
description: A man who cannot cook joins an evening cooking class.
instructions: Read the text about a cooking class, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Daniel is thirty years old, and he lives alone in a small flat. For many years, he ate pizza or noodles from the shop every evening. He did not know how to cook anything. One day, his doctor told him to eat more fresh food.

So Daniel joined a cooking class at the community centre. The class is on Wednesday evenings from seven to nine. There are eight students, and the teacher is a friendly woman called Rosa. In the first lesson, they learned how to make a simple vegetable soup.

Daniel was nervous at first. He cut the carrots too slowly, and he put too much salt in his soup. Rosa laughed kindly and showed him how to fix it. At the end of the lesson, everyone ate their soup together at a long table.

Now Daniel cooks at home three or four times a week. His favourite dish is chicken with rice and green beans. Last Sunday, he invited his sister for dinner for the first time. She was surprised and asked for the recipe.

His sister was not the only surprised person. At work, Daniel's colleagues noticed that he brought his own lunch every day. Sometimes it was soup, and sometimes it was a salad with eggs and tomatoes. One colleague, Tom, asked Daniel to teach him some easy dishes. Daniel laughed, because only a few months ago he could not even boil an egg.

After six months, Daniel went back to his doctor. The doctor was very happy with him. Daniel was lighter, and he felt much healthier. 'What did you change?' the doctor asked. Daniel told her about Rosa's class and his new hobby. 'Cooking is cheaper than buying food from the shop too,' he said with a smile.

Now Daniel is in a new class for better cooks. He is learning to make bread and fish dishes. Rosa sometimes asks him to help the new students when they are nervous. Daniel tells them, 'I was the worst cook in the class, and now I love it. Don't worry about mistakes!' Next month, he is going to cook a big dinner for his whole family, and he is already planning the menu.
